original_ai_output.title_zh: NDC候选人质疑拉各斯辩论事实核查员对其1.77万亿奈拉IGR主张的指控
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚民主党大会拉各斯州州长候选人Funso Doherty公开质疑周日拉各斯州长辩论中的事实核查员，称其错误指控他提供虚假信息，并要求对方道歉。Doherty表示，他关于拉各斯州内部生成收入高于31个州合计的说法依据国家统计局数据，即2025年拉各斯州IGR为1.77万亿奈拉，而其他31个州合计为1.73万亿奈拉。该报道目前仅来自单一来源Punch。

key_facts.fact: NDC拉各斯州州长候选人Funso Doherty质疑辩论事实核查员对其提供虚假信息的指控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The governorship candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress in Lagos State, Funso Doherty, has challenged the fact-checkers at Sunday’s Lagos Governorship Debate for accusing him of giving out false information.

key_facts.fact: Doherty要求事实核查员就其内部生成收入主张的错误评估道歉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He also demanded an apology over what he described as an incorrect assessment of his claim about the state’s internally generated revenue.

key_facts.fact: Doherty称其主张依据国家统计局数据，拉各斯州2025年IGR为1.77万亿奈拉，其他31州合计1.73万亿奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He maintained that his claim was based on data from the National Bureau of Statistics, which put Lagos State’s internally generated revenue at N1.77tn, compared with N1.73tn generated by 31 other states combined in 2025.

uncertainties: 事实核查员与候选人之间的数据争议尚未获得独立核实
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
